summary: Entrepreneur. Founder of Valmeto; founder, former captain and lead mentor of FRC #10141 Turing Robotics. Member of the Turkish Rugby Federation’s Central Referee Committee and a licensed rugby player. Writes on physics and philosophy.

experience.title: Founder & former team captain · Lead mentor
